about_the_game:
Scav is about scavenging — survive the raid, or lose everything trying.

  • Scav is a low poly looter shooter with survival elements, set in a world where every infected zone is scheduled for nuclear extermination. When the outbreak hits, you're dropped in to scavenge what’s left — and get out before the blast.

  • Start your journey in the safezone, a private haven where you can store your gear, stash your cash in the bank, buy weapons, tools, and properties, or customize your character's appearance. Stock up at vendor shops, prepare your loadout, and ready up for the next raid.

  • Load into an abandoned, overgrown city — a quarantine zone surrounded by sand and the dead. You've got one goal: loot everything you can before the nuclear sanitation protocol wipes the place off the map. With a ticking clock and the undead roaming the zone, every raid is a deadly gamble.

  • Search buildings, underground bunkers, and radiation zones for valuable gear and rare items. Secure what you can, extract alive, and return home — or die and lose it all.

  • Invest in properties. Plan your builds around upcoming updates like crafting, farming, and manufacturing.
